purpose: Make curriculum alignment, review, approval, and accreditation claims explicit and evidence-bounded so demonstration capsules cannot silently present themselves as officially verified courses.

ontario_demonstration_default.claim: Designed to align as closely as practicable with the identified published Ontario curriculum sources at the time of creation. Unless an assurance record explicitly states otherwise, it is not Ministry-approved, school-board-approved, qualified-human-reviewed, accredited, or an Ontario credit-bearing course.

non_claims: Axiom Education does not infer official approval from curriculum similarity.
Automated source comparison is not a substitute for qualified human review where human review is claimed.
A demonstration capsule may be useful and highly aligned without being accredited.
Accreditation is represented only when the applicable authorized body and evidence explicitly support that claim.
